shared_elements: carved relief motifs on a stone surface
circular/disc motifs (A: roundels; B: shield/wheel circles)
justification: A is a monolithic, frontal anthropomorphic figure whose body is covered with scattered low-relief roundels, bosses and abstract emblems, with no narrative interaction between them; B is a narrative battle panel with archers in profile drawing bows, a wheeled siege engine and crenellated city walls arranged in a horizontal register. Beyond the shared use of low-relief carving and the incidental presence of disc shapes, there is no correspondence in subject, figure posture, spatial relationships or compositional scheme.
